A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FALCON-SFOD work and contain complete, readable main texts and appendices. Text extraction and visual comparison support reliable assessment of the methods, equations, experiments and displays.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection experiments, component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, repeated-seed results and resource measurements in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and analyses, including the benchmark results and appendix seed and resource measurements.

M1.justification: The SPAR and IRPL objectives, offline foreground-mask generation, mean-teacher procedure and Algorithm 1 are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A.1.

E1.justification: Tables 1–4 retain the same driving-domain, synthetic-to-real, cross-camera, realistic-to-artistic and RGB/thermal transfer scenarios. No dataset, task or evaluated population is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–4 and A.1, including the corresponding Simple-SFOD, IRG, PETS, DRU and SF-YOLO comparisons. Table 6 also retains the same source-map and segmentation-mask alternatives.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A.3 retain the same splits, AP evaluation at IoU 0.5, detector configurations and training settings. These include batch size 4, EMA decay 0.9996, confidence threshold 0.8 and fog intensity 0.02.

E4.justification: The component and mask-source ablations, mask-filtering comparison, long-tail analysis, hyperparameter sweeps and qualitative examples are retained unchanged. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix A.3.2 and Table A.3 retain the three seeds 42, 123 and 9999 and the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, including 47.0 ± 0.29 mAP.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 1 retains 46.9 mAP for Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes and car AP values of 58.8 and 50.1 for Sim10k→Cityscapes and KITTI→Cityscapes; appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, two lemmas and two theorems in Section 4, together with their proofs in Appendix A.4, are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about object-focused representations, SPAR and IRPL, theoretical risk bounds and competitive SFOD performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of foreground alignment, long-tail gains, noise robustness and architectural generality remain unchanged. Appendix A.3.1 retains the same qualifications about excessive margin, foreground weighting and entropy regularization.

D1.justification: v3 deletes Section 5's promise to make code public upon acceptance and Appendix A.3's statement that an anonymized implementation ZIP is supplied in the supplementary material. Other implementation and resource details remain unchanged. Actual code availability cannot be determined from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The same 36 references and related-work discussion are retained, including the positioning against existing SFOD methods, foundation-model approaches and noise-robust learning.

P1.justification: Editing is limited to the two code-access sentence deletions and the updated arXiv version/date marking. Section organization, terminology and the scientific narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The deletions produce modest text reflow and spacing or vertical-position changes around Tables 7–8 and A.2. Figures, table structures, captions and graphical content are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 removes the code-release commitment and supplementary implementation pointer without replacement access guidance, modestly weakening reproducibility documentation. The scientific content and evidence remain unchanged. This assessment concerns the documentation; the PDFs do not establish whether actual code availability changed.
